No, HCA Healthcare, Inc. did not announce any changes to its dividend policy in the annual report. The report states that the Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.60 per share payable on March 31, 2023, and that future declarations of quarterly dividends and the establishment of future record and payment dates are subject to the final determination of the Board of Directors. It also notes that there can be no assurance that dividends will continue and that dividend declarations depend on various factors including capital availability and Board determinations, but no change to the dividend policy itself was announced [S1, S3, S5].

Yes, Brave Bison Group plc mentioned acquisitions in the annual report. The acquisition of Best Response Media expanded their ecommerce platform services to include Adobe Commerce Cloud and brought in Tier 1 customers such as NatWest [S1][S2][S4][S9].
